title: Editor asks Avi Loeb to cut alien paragraph from 3I/ATLAS paper

tellings.quote: he said, he was telling this on a Zoom meeting. The journal editor goes, "Okay, this is a great paper, but you have to take out the final paragraph."

plain: In 2025 a science journal editor told the astronomer Avi Loeb that his paper on 3I/ATLAS, an object passing through our solar system from outside it, was great but that he had to take out the final paragraph, the one raising the idea of aliens. Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic, tells this, saying Loeb himself described it on a Zoom call. It is told as an example of how scientific journals handle talk of alien life.
